channel.title: Cloudsigma incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Cloudsigma's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: [MNL2] Hardware Maintenance [maintenance]
item.description: Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.

item.title: [ZRH][GVA] Network Issue [resolved]
item.description:
For the past several hours, the platform has remained stable, with no new signs of instability. We will continue monitoring the network and the state of the devices to ensure everything remains stable.
Please accept our apologies for the issues and any inconvenience caused, and thank you for your patience and understanding during the problems experienced.
If there is anything else we could assist you with, please do not hesitate to reach out to us.

item.title: [ZRH][GVA] Network outage [resolved]
item.description:
Dear Valued Customers,
We would like to inform you that the issues encountered in the Zurich cloud have been resolved.
All services in the cloud infrastructure have been restored to normal operations.
If you encounter any issues with your service, please let us know right away.
A detailed RCA of the incident will be distributed to all affected clients in the next 24 hours.
Please accept our sincere apologies for the inconvenience caused.

item.title: [GVA] Inaccessible PaaS Panel [investigating]
item.description:
CloudSigma would like to inform you that we are currently experiencing an issue affecting the PaaS platform in our Geneva cloud location.
The PaaS panel in the WebApp is currently inaccessible. Our Operations team is actively working to restore PaaS availability, and we will provide further updates as soon as more information becomes available.
Please accept our sincere apologies for any inconvenience caused and thank you for your patience and understanding.

item.title: [MNL2][CRK] Connectivity Issues [resolved]
item.description:
CloudSigma would like to inform you that the connectivity issues affecting our upstream ISP have been resolved.
Connectivity in the affected Clark and Manila2 locations has been restored, and services should now be operating normally. We will continue to monitor the situation to ensure stable connectivity.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your patience and understanding.

item.title: [CRK] Inaccessible PaaS Panel [resolved]
